name: Mashal
overview: The term 'Mashal' refers to a Levitical city located within the territory of the tribe of Asher, also known by the variant names Mishal and Misheal. Scripture identifies this city and its surrounding suburbs as part of the inheritance given to the Levites, emphasizing its role in the distribution of land among the tribes of Israel. The passages in Joshua 19:26, Joshua 21:30, and 1 Chronicles 6:74 consistently affirm Mashal's place within Asher's borders and its significance as a Levitical city.
